outputs.explanation: This is a spatial map of tissue clusters (categorical spatial/heatmap-style display), not a bar chart of an average requiring overlaid individual data points.
H&E histology images with manual region annotations; not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Spatial gene-expression heatmap overlays on tissue images; heatmap-type displays are exempt from requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment score line plots; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values for differentially expressed genes with only p-values annotated; no individual data points (e.g., per-spot expression values) are overlaid on the bars.
